title: The Paired Hawk Qi Course
summary: A school course in paired plunging strokes of plain qi that closes on the descent of two hawks as one blow.

title: Manual of the Azure Court Circuit
summary: A school manual of strokes that pass edict on a foe and end in the absolute edict of the azure court.

title: The Twin River Qi Canon
summary: A school canon of two streams of qi braided in strike and guard that crown in one braided stroke.

title: The Azure Sky Qi of Two Tracks
summary: A school text on running plain qi down two tracks in duet and uniting them in a single final surge.

title: Canon of the Hawk's Highest Breath
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the pinnacle of the hawk's breath and its great descent.

title: The Sworn Breath Course
summary: A school course in qi pledged on the breath and carried through each stroke to the pledge fulfilled.

title: Manual of the Plateau Oath Pulse
summary: A school manual of the resolute pulse sworn on the plateau and carried to its sundering stroke.

title: The Gale Bearing Qi Canon
summary: A school canon of steadfast qi on a held bearing that ends in the stroke of the course held true.

title: The Great Draw of the Sworn Field
summary: A school text on the taut draw of the sworn field from the first drill to the hundredfold release.

title: Canon of the Oath Unbroken by Strain
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the unyielding oath that no strain can bend and its finale.
